rules.paymentsIncluded: Stripe checkout is included with Own Your Bookings, Own Your Bookings Plus, Business Site Essentials and every website package above them. Payments & Back-End Integration is sold on its own for everything else.
rules.flatVsStarting: priceMode flat = a fixed template product at that price. priceMode starting_at = the entry price of a scoped build; a written scope confirms the final price.
rules.thirdParty: Stripe processing fees, Google subscriptions, and domain renewals after year one are separate unless an item says otherwise.
rules.campaigns: Ads read price and name from this file through scripts/campaign-brief.mjs. Never put a price in an ad that this file and /pricing do not show.
rules.pricingBasis: 2026-11 v3: every price cut 30% from v2 and rounded down to a clean number. Owner-developer model: the owner builds the work and reuses proven FTD systems, so there is no agency markup.

veteran.appliesTo: every active item, on top of these prices
veteran.verification: Proof first (DD-214, VA ID card, or a VOSB/SDVOSB certificate), then a single-use code from scripts/veteran-code.mjs. Proof documents are never stored on the website.

yobul.appliesTo: items with yobulEligible true, as a quote-time discount

discounts.stacking: One discount per order: veteran 30% or YOBUL 20%, not both.

paymentPlans.deposit: Items with depositPercent: start with that share of the starting price; the balance is invoiced at design approval and at launch.
paymentPlans.payOverTime: Affirm, Afterpay and Klarna at Stripe checkout once enabled in the Stripe Dashboard (Settings > Payment methods). FTD is paid in full; the provider approves the customer and sets the terms. Affirm $50-$30,000, Afterpay $1-$4,000, Klarna $10+.
